description: Write, update, or overwrite content of an existing file in a knowledge base, optionally with an expected_content_hash precondition (optimistic concurrency). For git knowledge bases: commits to managed branch. Re-chunks and updates memories.
embedding_description: Update, revise, overwrite, or save changes to a document that already exists in a knowledge base — typically a markdown (.md) file — replacing its text with new content. Optionally pass expected_content_hash (the content_sha256 from read_file) so a stale overwrite fails loud instead of silently clobbering a concurrent writer's change; some knowledge bases require that precondition. For git-backed KBs the change is committed to the managed branch, then the file is re-chunked and re-indexed. This is the way to revise a workbench planning document: workbench requires the hash precondition, so read_file first and pass its content_sha256. Use to modify or correct an existing document, not to create a new one.

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: file not found. PathTraversalError: path escapes KB root.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use browse to verify the file path, or use create_file for new files.
